events.title: Changes
events.hint: One-off turning points that are not a value: a new WDT tool, a puck screen, a different basket, a change of technique. Every later shot belongs to that change's era.
events.what_placeholder: WDT tool, puck screen, 18g VST basket…
stats.per_era_hint: Shots between two changes. Before the WDT vs. after.
maint.title: Maintenance
maint.hint: Backflushing and Cafiza are worn down by coffee, scale by water. A backflush is recognised on its own from a run on the utility profile; Cafiza and descaling you record with a button. Red only when overdue.
maint.intervals_hint: Defaults are the usual figures for a Gaggia Classic. Water hardness and filtering vary more than machines do, so everything can be changed.
maint.cafiza_hint: The machine cannot see chemistry; this promotes the last detected backflush to a Cafiza run.
maint.why.backflush: A blind basket without chemistry washes oil out of the group and the solenoid. About every 15 coffees.
maint.why.cafiza: A backflush with detergent dissolves the oil water will not. About every 60 coffees; it counts as a plain backflush too.
maint.why.descale: Scale grows with water pumped, not with coffees. Lower it for hard, unfiltered water; raise it for filtered.
maint.why.water_filter: Replace after the volume the filter's maker states.
maint.why.gasket: A hardened gasket lets steam past the portafilter; usually lasts six months to a year.
